name: cloud-academy
description: Azure & AWS learning platform — quizzes, spaced-repetition flashcards, progress tracking. React 19 + Fastify + PostgreSQL.

scripts.dev: npm run db:up && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
